page.title: Public Landing
page.purpose: Present the selected landing-page variant, pricing, and subscription entry points after the runtime configuration is resolved.

priorities.statement: The selected landing experience becomes usable only after its runtime configuration reaches a terminal state.
Pricing and download entry points remain available from the resolved public experience.

states.description: The landing configuration is loading and the shell truthfully communicates preparation.
A selected or fallback landing configuration is rendered and its public content is usable.
Neither the runtime configuration nor the baked fallback configuration could be resolved.

regions.purpose: Render the public landing experience through loading, ready, and configuration-failure states.

elements.description: Sticky branding and public navigation for the resolved landing experience.

claims.statement: The resolved public landing experience exposes its header as a perceivable banner.
While the landing configuration loads, the public surface communicates preparation instead of presenting a blank page.
claims.rationale: Live reconciliation captures the ready state; the loading state is covered by the route guard regression test.
